seam_tests.support: the expanded prescript and greeting conclude before the joy report opens the body
seam_tests.resistance: truth and love vocabulary binds the greeting to the following exhortation

seam_tests.support: the recursive command definition closes before the stated reason for warning
seam_tests.resistance: the rationale connects walking in the command to the danger that follows

seam_tests.support: the participation consequence completes the reception case before the writing-medium transition
seam_tests.resistance: the closing intention remains part of the same short-letter communicative situation

proposed_units.rationale: The sender/addressee construction, continuing truth-ground, and grace-mercy-peace declaration make one expanded prescript and greeting before the joy report.
proposed_units.premortem: Splitting at verse 2 strands the truth-ground from the address or greeting; merging through verse 6 obscures the body-opening joy report and exhortation.
holds: no elder authorship or identity selection
no chosen-lady or children identity selection
no Jesus Christ genitive or Christology ruling

proposed_units.rationale: The joy report supplies the walking frame for the request, while the request and linked definitions explain love and command as walking; detaching verse 6 would break that recursive definition.
proposed_units.premortem: A verse-by-verse split atomizes joy, request, and definition; a cut at verse 5 detaches the command from its definition; a merge through verse 11 flattens the warning onset.

proposed_units.rationale: The deceiver rationale grounds the self-watch command and reward consequence; the abiding contrast specifies the warning, and the conditional reception instruction remains joined to its participation consequence.
proposed_units.premortem: Cutting after verse 7 detaches warning from rationale; cutting verse 8 from verse 9 separates warning and test; cutting verses 10 and 11 divides condition, instruction, and consequence; merging into the close hides the writing transition.
holds: no pronoun or reward textual-reading selection
no teaching-of-Christ genitive or Christology ruling
no hospitality discipline church policy assurance doctrine or theology selection

markers: children of your chosen sister greet you
proposed_units.rationale: The postponed writing, intended face-to-face speech, and joy purpose form the epistolary close, completed by the final greeting; the greeting should not be isolated as a one-verse fragment.
proposed_units.premortem: Splitting verse 13 makes the final greeting an isolated fragment; merging backward through verse 11 obscures the completed case/consequence and distinct writing-intention close.
holds: no chosen-sister children identity or location selection
